crossRefs.note: For as in Adam all die, so also in Christ all will be made alive.
Therefore as sin entered into the world through one man, and death through sin; so death passed to all men, because all…
Jesus said to her, “I am the resurrection and the life. He who believes in me will still live, even if he dies.
For the wages of sin is death, but the free gift of God is eternal life in Christ Jesus our Lord.

translations.web: For since death came by man, the resurrection of the dead also came by man.
translations.bsb: For since death came through a man, the resurrection of the dead comes also through a man.
translations.kjv: For since by man came death, by man came also the resurrection of the dead.
translations.asv: For since by man came death, by man came also the resurrection of the dead.
